Sorry about the double charge. Since both have posted, please reply with your order number (LF-310022) and the **last four digits** of the card used. Once we confirm the duplicate, it will be refunded within **3 business days**.

Please don't send your full card number, security code, or any passwords.

One thing to check first: if your order shipped in several parcels, it can legitimately show one charge per parcel. If the two amounts match the full order total each, though, it's likely a true duplicate.
